items.title: Deja Vu: Salesforce Customers Hacked Again, Via Gainsight
items.description: In a repeat of similar attacks during the summer, threat actors affiliated with the ShinyHunters extortion group used a third-party application to steal organizations' Salesforce data.

items.title: LINE Messaging Bugs Open Asian Users to Cyber Espionage
items.description: In a potential gift to geopolitical adversaries, the encrypted messaging app uses a leaky custom protocol that allows message replays, impersonation attacks, and sensitive information exposure from chats.

items.title: Cloudflare's One-Stop-Shop Convenience Takes Down Global Digital Economy
items.description: Even the most advanced systems like Cloudflare can fall victim to software issues and become a global point of failure, Dr. David Utzke argues, adding that the recent outage should be a warning for enterprises.

items.title: Hack the Hackers: 6 Laws for Staying Ahead of the Attackers
items.description: A new security framework responds to a shift in attackers' tactics, one that allows them to infiltrate enterprises 'silently' through their own policies.

items.title: AI-Based Obfuscated Malicious Apps Evading AV Detection to Deploy Malicious Payload
items.description: A new wave of malicious Android applications impersonating a well-known Korean delivery service has emerged, featuring advanced obfuscation techniques powered by artificial intelligence. These apps work to bypass traditional antivirus detection methods while extracting sensitive user information. The threat actors behind this campaign have demonstrated sophisticated knowledge of mobile security…
